Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
The technical specification of the P max = 1.8 MW, H max = 5.5m, Q = 50m3/s, D = 3600 mm, speed = 90.58/1000 RPM,
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohamed, tested at Nag Hammadi 
Hyd. PS, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Halem: HPGC MPIS coordinator, QC 
general director.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Stop the unit and CB out, and earthing transformer
Hang suitable warning boards
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrenches, cleaning material
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating (multi purpose grease, Kaplan turbine)
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the 
 equipments
Grease the wicket 
 gate pines
Grease the open and 
 close wicket gate mechanism
Clean and grease the 
 generator coupling
Check up the oil 
 head group (oil leakage, gland)
Check the stuffing 
 box and tighten the bolts
Check the turbine 
 guide bearing
Check the level of 
 the hub oil
Check the noise 
 after operation
Check bearing 
 temperature
Check the water 
 leakage from the guide vane
